units.recipes.time_to_make: raw TimeToMake from the game table, seconds
units.recipes.seconds_per_op: TimeToMake / RefinerSubsMadeInTime (250) for substance results, / RefinerProductsMadeInTime (2) for product results; one op consumes 'ingredients' and yields 'result.amount'. Verify against two save snapshots of one refiner before trusting an ETA.
units.extraction.resource_units_per_item: link-grid resource units per inventory item (AmountCost / yield)
units.extraction.items_per_hour_at_strength_1: extractor rate_per_s * 3600 / resource_units_per_item, at a class-C hotspot with the extractor on the hotspot centre; multiply by class_strength and the survey-device percentage
units.buildings.rate_per_s: link-grid units per second; negative = consumes. Power network units are kP.
units.buildings.storage: link-grid units; for Resources networks divide by resource_units_per_item to get items (extractor 250, supply depot 1000); for Power it is kPs (battery 45000); for PlantGrowth it is seconds to mature
units.fleet.events_by_duration: number of expedition events per duration class; an expedition lasts events * event_seconds from StartTime
units.save.base_object.UserData: for U_EXTRACTOR_S / U_SILO_S the upper 32 bits hold the current fill in resource units (divide by resource_units_per_item); the base's LastUpdateTimestamp says when
